result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect in `config.json` no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `exportZips()`.

The five entries were hardcoded as `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and so on. Now they are derived per aspect with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose files. The order is unchanged, and with the default config the entries are the same as before. I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import.

The reports module compiles and its `*DataExport*` tests pass offline. I did not add a test for the renamed-aspect case or run the export end to end on a renamed config, so that path is verified by reading only.

Nothing is committed.
